summary.zh: 为团队配置和推广 Claude Code
summary.en: Set up and roll out Claude Code across a team.

description.zh: 为团队或组织规划 Claude Code 的落地方式：共享设置、MCP 与扩展的审批规则、分层的项目说明文件，以及成员推广的节奏。适合第一次给多人配置，或想确认现有配置是否合理时使用。
description.en: Plans how a team or org adopts Claude Code: shared settings, MCP and extension approvals, layered project instruction files and a rollout sequence. Use it for a first team setup or to check whether existing config files are sound.
